<div style="max-width:900px;margin:0 auto 1.5rem;">
  <p style="font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1.6;color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--bs-body-color) 72%,transparent);">
  The Parenzana was once a narrow-gauge railway threading through Austro-Hungarian Istria —
  123 km from Trieste to Poreč, completed in 1902 and abandoned in 1935. Now it's a cycling
  trail crossing three countries, through old stone tunnels, hilltop villages, and down to
  the Adriatic.</p>
</div>
